'''Torsjiman Hunt Deck (HD)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Torsjiman]]
* '''Published:''' 27 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Holotheatre|Dagobah-D-executorholotheatre.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Holotheatre
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Executor Holotheatre Torsjiman DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Basic Hunt Deck

The published list has 58 cards.
